text:
sree: heads up — after pushing the preflight + splitter v2 to canary, we started seeing a small spike (~0.8%) of 413s for mixed-dim payloads. repro in staging but also a few production traces. wondering if the preflight estimation is underestimating units when dims vary within a batch.

jordan: do we have an example request + server response?

sree: yep, pasted a minimal repro:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"embed-large-v2","inputs":[{"text":"short","dim":768},{"text":"longer text...","dim":1536}]}' ;
```
response: 413 with body `{"error":"oversize payload","code":"EMBED_OVERSIZE","hint":"try splitting or reduce dims"}` and no `X-Estimated-Units` header.

marya: interesting — v1 preflight always returned an estimated-units header even when rejecting. v2 apparently only does a boolean pass/fail. that makes client fast-fail harder.

kevin: +1. From runtime traces the splitter chooses the mixed route causing an intermediate sizing calc to round down. telemetry shows `embed.preflight.estimate_ratio` ~0.85 for mixed-dim batches in canary.

lia: UX concern: console error card shows just "413 Oversize" with no actionable split suggestion or sample split plan. customers are confused. can we add a quick actionable hint like "split into N batches: [sizes]"?

sree: propose 3-part plan: (1) include `X-Estimated-Units` and `X-Split-Suggestion` in rejection responses, (2) tweak estimator to overprovision by 10% for mixed dims, (3) add console tooltip and a small rollout flag `embed.preflight.v2.softfail=true` to keep v1 behavior during canary.

jordan: sounds reasonable. question: can we compute `X-Split-Suggestion` cheaply? we don't want preflight to become expensive and add 10s latency.

kevin: we can use the same approximate knapsack we already run in splitter, but switch to a fast heuristic for preflight (greedy by dim descending) and cap runtime to 2ms. it's approximate but good enough for hints.

marya: telemetry requests: we should add metrics for `embed.preflight.suggested_splits.count`, `embed.preflight.reject_reason`, and tag by `route_type` (uniform|mixed). also add a dashboard panel that shows reject rate, avg suggestion accuracy (suggested split that would have prevented reject), and per-tenant freq.

lia: for console, UI mock: show last 3 rejects for tenant with example `X-Split-Suggestion` and a small "Apply auto-split" toggle that will auto-retry using suggestion on behalf of client (opt-in). that will reduce surface for support tickets.

ops-bot: alert triggered: alert/embed-preflight-oversize-canary firing 3 times in last 10m for canary cluster `embed-canary-3`.

kevin: ok to implement responses + estimator change behind `--feature embed_preflight_v2_softfail`? i'll PR the estimator change + header in API handler. need someone to own dashboard panels and the console hint card.

marya: i'll own the dashboards. can you add PromQL suggestions? quick ones: `sum(rate(embed_preflight_reject_total[5m])) by (route_type)` and `sum(rate(embed_preflight_suggested_splits_total[5m])) by (tenant)`; and a panel for `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(embed_preflight_estimate_ratio_bucket[5m])) by (le))` to spot underestimates.

jordan: testing plan: load-test mixed-dim with realistic mix (70% small, 30% large) and compare v1 vs v2 preflight under both `softfail=true/false`. capture 95th latency of preflight + false reject rate.

sree: timeline suggestion: patch -> internal canary (embed-canary-3) for 48h with dashboards and alerting, if rejects drop -> canary to subset of prod (10%) for 24h, then full rollout. if any tenant hits >1% delta in reject_rate, auto-disable via flag.

lia: note on client SDKs: we should emit the new headers in SDKs and surface split suggestions in client exceptions. I'll draft a small spec for SDK change.

sree: thanks all — kevin open the API PR and tag me, marya please add dashboard and alert smoke tests. i'll coordinate the rollout doc. :thumbsup:
